From Source to Machine Code
XLA & LLVM
•Pipeline 
Source (Julia/Python) → Front-end IR →  Optimizer  →  Machine Code
•XLA: linear-algebra-centric compiler used by JAX / TF; IR = HLO
•LLVM: language-agnostic compiler back-end (Julia, C/C++, Rust)
:::
